status: EXPLORATORY, post hoc: previously inspected captures; rules chosen after the data were seen (reviewer request, textbook conventions); nothing tuned on these outputs; nothing confirmatory

rules.min_cv: argmin CV MSE over {A, R(lambda), F}; exact ties -> simpler
rules.one_se: simplest candidate (A < R(largest lambda) < ... < R(smallest) < F) with CV MSE <= min + donor-level SE of the minimising candidate's CV MSE
rules.paired: F iff the 95% t-interval (df = n_donors - 1) of mean donor-level [MSE(F) - MSE(A)] lies below 0; else A

estimands.se: donor-level: sd over the 16 validation donors / sqrt(16) (fold-level SEs stored in rows, unused); nominal
estimands.delta_FA_rel: (CV MSE(F) - CV MSE(A)) / var(training single-site readouts); negative favours F
estimands.R2_J: held-out joint rows with both donors held out, response_diagnostics.score
estimands.RMSE_T: sqrt(mean (T_C - T_hat)^2) over held-out joint rows, logits; T_C measured from executed quartets (fourpoint_modelfree.quartets), T_hat = model_contrast of the refit model; zero.RMSE_T = rms(T_C)
estimands.ridge_local: the paper's ridge control (argmin CV over the ridge grid alone) with family-local, fold-local whitening; ridge_pooled = response_diagnostics.ridge_cv with the paper's pooled whitening
estimands.aggregation: per seed: counts / medians over captures; across seeds: seed0, median over seeds 1-9 [min, max], median over seeds 0-9

checks.F_numerics_note: F is whitening-invariant in exact arithmetic; where its joint predictions are off by 1e3-1e7 logits (controls, d >= 3) rounding in a near-singular design makes lstsq/single-site-whitening and FWL/pooled-whitening disagree in those astronomically wrong values; no conclusion depends on it
